text:
alex: Heads up — canary promo failed CI on staging, looks like e2e hitting DB migration lock + cache stamp mismatch.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion job 8721 failed: stage=integration-e2e status=failed
deploy-bot: failed step: 'apply-schema-migrations' -> timeout (300s)
deploy-bot: logs: `ERROR: migration lock timeout; cache stamp mismatch for key 'user_profile_v2'`

jamie: Ugh. That's the migration that adds the profile_tags column. It has a short-lock window but the caching layer sometimes invalidates keys mid-migration.

sasha: Are we seeing the same with local reproduce? I can try running the migration against a copy of staging DB and kill the cache process to see the timing.

alex: Repro locally by running `./scripts/run-e2e --focus=profile-migration` — I hit the same error once when redis evicted the prefix.

morgan: If caching evicts and some services read stale schema, we get schema mismatch errors in tests. Quick options: 1) Pin to previous image (no migration) and promote; 2) Rollback migration in canary and debug; 3) Hold release window and run a coordinated migration + cache drain.

jamie: I'm leaning to hold the release window for 1 hour and run coordinated drain + migration. We risk breaking customers if we pin too long. But we need a reliable path.

sasha: Agree on hold. Also, we should add a migration readiness check in the CI gating: a tiny job that asserts cache TTL semantics for migration keys.

alex: For immediate unblock — can we revert the migration commit on canary and promote without data schema change? That means pinning the service image before the migration PR was merged.

morgan: Yes, we can pin to image sha: `sha256:4f8a1b2d` (pre-migration). But that will leave the DB still containing new columns if any previous attempt partially applied. Need to confirm migration didn't do partial writes.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Manual action: start pin rollout to sha256:4f8a1b2d? Use `/release pin 8721 sha256:4f8a1b2d`

jamie: @alex @sasha please run a quick check: `SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='profiles' AND column_name='profile_tags';` on staging. If zero, pin is safe.

alex: Ran check — returns 0. No profile_tags column present. Looks like migration didn't partially apply. Pining seems safe.

sasha: Good. I'll trigger the pin and ask infra to hold other canaries.

morgan: Also add to release notes that we delayed the schema migration for a coordinated rollout and include rollback steps. Product needs to know impact.

jamie: Noted — I'll draft a short blurb for release notes and notify the PMs.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Pin rollout started for job 8721 -> sha256:4f8a1b2d. Canary promotion paused.

alex: After pin completes, run the integration smoke suite only (no migrations) to verify the pinned image behaves. If green, promote.

sasha: Running smoke now: `./ci/run-smoke --canary 8721`
sasha: smoke suite passed ✅

morgan: OK promote after all clear, but plan a scheduled migration in the next change window with a cache-drain playbook. I want a prescript: drain-cache -> run-migration -> validate-schema -> re-enable cache.

jamie: I'll schedule the change window for tomorrow 02:00 UTC and include the playbook steps + rollback commands.

alex: One offnote: add a shortcheck to the CI gating that fails if `cache.ttl < migration_safe_ttl` for any key prefix used by migrations. That should have caught this.

sasha: I'll file the follow-up ticket and include a unit for the migration readiness check.

morgan: Thanks everyone. Slack thread summary for CX: pin applied, canary paused, smoke passed, release windows delayed for coordinated migration. I'll update release tracker. :thumbsup:

jamie: tagging @product-beth and @ops on the notes.

alex: closing the loop — will follow up with the ticket link once created.
